info.title: OpenLineage
info.description: OpenLineage is an open source **lineage and metadata collection API** for the data ecosystem.

post.summary: Send an event related to the state of a run
post.description: Updates a run state for a job.

415.description: Unsupported media type; requests must use application/json

eventTime.description: the time the event occurred at

producer.description: URI identifying the producer of this metadata. Legacy producers may send a non-URI identifier.

schemaURL.description: The JSON Pointer (https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc6901) URL to the corresponding version of the schema definition for this RunEvent

BaseFacet.description: all fields of the base facet are prefixed with _ to avoid name conflicts in facets

_producer.description: URI identifying the producer of this metadata. For example this could be a git url with a given tag or sha

_schemaURL.description: The JSON Pointer (https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc6901) URL to the corresponding version of the schema definition for this facet

runId.description: The globally unique ID of the run associated with the job.

_deleted.description: set to true to delete a facet

name.description: The unique name for that job within that namespace

_deleted.description: set to true to delete a facet

name.description: The unique name for that dataset within that namespace

inputFacets.description: The input facets for this dataset.

outputFacets.description: The output facets for this dataset

eventType.description: the current transition of the run state. It is required to issue 1 START event and 1 of [ COMPLETE, ABORT, FAIL ] event per run. Additional events with OTHER eventType can be added to the same run. For example to send additional metadata after the run is complete

StaticDataset.description: A Dataset sent within static metadata events

framework.description: The storage framework for which the catalog is configured

name.description: Name of the catalog, as configured in the source system.

metadataUri.description: URI or connection string to the catalog, if applicable.

warehouseUri.description: URI or connection string to the physical location of the data that the catalog describes.

source.description: Source system where the catalog is configured.

fields.description: Column level lineage that maps output fields into input fields used to evaluate them.

transformationDescription.description: a string representation of the transformation applied

transformationType.description: IDENTITY|MASKED reflects a clearly defined behavior. IDENTITY: exact same as input; MASKED: no original data available (like a hash of PII for example)

dataset.description: Column level lineage that affects the whole dataset. This includes filtering, sorting, grouping (aggregates), joining, window functions, etc.

InputField.description: Represents a single dependency on some field (column).

type.description: The type of the transformation. Allowed values are: DIRECT, INDIRECT

description.description: a string representation of the transformation applied

masking.description: is transformation masking the data or not

DataQualityAssertionsDatasetFacet.description: list of tests performed on dataset or dataset columns, and their results

assertion.description: Type of expectation test that dataset is subjected to

column.description: Column that expectation is testing. It should match the name provided in SchemaDatasetFacet. If column field is empty, then expectation refers to whole dataset.

columnMetrics.description: The property key is the column name

nullCount.description: The number of null values in this column for the rows evaluated

distinctCount.description: The number of distinct values in this column for the rows evaluated

sum.description: The total sum of values in this column for the rows evaluated

count.description: The number of values in this column

quantiles.description: The property key is the quantile. Examples: 0.1 0.25 0.5 0.75 1

subType.description: Optional sub-type within the dataset type (e.g., BEST VALIDATION under MODEL CHECKPOINT).

name.description: The name of the environment variable.

value.description: The value of the environment variable.

environmentVariables.description: The environment variables for the run.

message.description: A human-readable string representing error message generated by observed system
message.example: org.apache.spark.sql.AnalysisException: Table or view not found: wrong_table_name; line 1 pos 14

programmingLanguage.description: Programming language the observed system uses.

stackTrace.description: A language-specific stack trace generated by observed system
stackTrace.example:
Exception in thread "main" java.lang.RuntimeException: A test exception
at io.openlineage.SomeClass.method(SomeClass.java:13)
at io.openlineage.SomeClass.anotherMethod(SomeClass.java:9)

totalTasks.description: The number of distinguishable tasks in a run that were processed by OpenLineage, whether successfully or not. Those could be, for example, distinct SQL statements.

failedTasks.description: The number of distinguishable tasks in a run that were processed not successfully by OpenLineage. Those could be, for example, distinct SQL statements.

errorMessage.description: Text representation of extraction error message.

stackTrace.description: Stack trace of extraction error message

task.description: Text representation of task that failed. This can be, for example, SQL statement that parser could not interpret.

processingType.description: Job processing type like: BATCH or STREAMING

integration.description: OpenLineage integration type of this job: for example SPARK|DBT|AIRFLOW|FLINK

jobType.description: Run type, for example: QUERY|COMMAND|DAG|TASK|JOB|MODEL. This is an integration-specific field.

previousIdentifier.description: Previous name of the dataset in case of renaming it.

nominalStartTime.description: An [ISO-8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) timestamp representing the nominal start time (included) of the run. AKA the schedule time

nominalEndTime.description: An [ISO-8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) timestamp representing the nominal end time (excluded) of the run. (Should be the nominal start time of the next run)

rowCount.description: The number of rows written to the dataset

size.description: The size in bytes written to the dataset

fileCount.description: The number of files written to the dataset

name.description: the identifier of the owner of the Dataset. It is recommended to define this as a URN. For example application:foo, user:jdoe, team:data
the identifier of the owner of the Job. It is recommended to define this as a URN. For example application:foo, user:jdoe, team:data

runId.description: The globally unique ID of the root run associated with the root job.

name.description: The unique name containing root job within that namespace

ParentRunFacet.description: the id of the parent run and job, iff this run was spawn from an other run (for example, the Dag run scheduling its tasks)

runId.description: The globally unique ID of the run associated with the job.

name.description: The unique name for that job within that namespace

version.description: Processing engine version. Might be Airflow or Spark version.

name.description: Processing engine name, e.g. Airflow or Spark

openlineageAdapterVersion.description: OpenLineage adapter package version. Might be e.g. OpenLineage Airflow integration package version

fields.description: The fields of the data source.

language.description: Language in which source code of this job was written.

url.description: the full http URL to locate the file

path.description: the path in the repo containing the source files

version.description: the current version deployed (not a branch name, the actual unique version)
version.example: git: the git sha | Svn: the revision number

storageLayer.description: Storage layer provider with allowed values: iceberg, delta.

fileFormat.description: File format with allowed values: parquet, orc, avro, json, csv, text, xml.

source.description: The source of the tag. INTEGRATION|USER|DBT CORE|SPARK|etc.

field.description: Identifies the field in a dataset if a tag applies to one

tags.description: The tags applied to the dataset facet

source.description: The source of the tag. INTEGRATION|USER|DBT CORE|SPARK|etc.

tags.description: The tags applied to the job facet

source.description: The source of the tag. INTEGRATION|USER|DBT CORE|SPARK|etc.

tags.description: The tags applied to the run facet

JobIdentifier.description: Used to identify an OpenLineage job.

name.description: The unique name of a job within that namespace

RunIdentifier.description: Used to identify an OpenLineage run.

runId.description: The globally unique ID of the run

JobDependency.description: Execution dependency metadata for an OpenLineage job.

dependency_type.description: Whether the dependency directly invokes the downstream job or is implicit.

status_trigger_rule.description: Upstream status condition governing downstream execution.

JobDependenciesRunFacet.description: Maps execution dependencies between upstream and downstream job runs.

upstream.description: Job runs that must complete before the current run can start.

downstream.description: Job runs that will start after completion of the current run.

trigger_rule.description: Condition under which this job runs based on upstream status.

hierarchy.description: Dataset hierarchy levels from highest to lowest; order is significant.
